'''Treesh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] working as a weaponsmith. He lived among the [[Myyydril]] tribe in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. He was responsible for keeping the tribe's soldiers armed with the best weapons he could muster.

==Biography==
In 1.5 ABY, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with the knowledge to craft weapons visited Treesh within the Myyydril Caverns and asked him to teach them what he knew. Treesh agreed to teach the spacer how to craft [[Nak'tra crystal]] knives. Unfortunately, Treesh had no crystals at the moment, so he set the spacer on the task of collecting fifteen of the crystals from the corpses of the [[Urnsor'is]] that infested the cavern. After the spacer had collected them, they brought them back to Treesh, who proceeded to teach the spacer how to make the knives.

==Behind the scenes==
Treesh is a non-playable character in the massively-multiplayer online role-playing game [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. He was added to the game, along with the planet Kashyyyk, in the [[2005]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']].

Treesh's quest is only available to players of the Trader (Munitions) profession within the game.
